purpose: Thirty final combinational IC circuits from user blueprint, generated from accepted donor-derived gate/passive records.
shared_rules: 74HC7266 in the prompt is normalized to the accepted Proteus donor family 74HC266.
Pin 14 and pin 7 supply instructions are accepted as user metadata but not emitted for IC packages.
R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR; V0/G0 special terminals appear only in passive mixed cases.
Circuit 30 does not emit a MOSFET because no MOSFET donor has been accepted yet.
